The provided knowledge contains information on two shoe models:

*   **Prototipo RS - Black/Red comfort**: This shoe offers all-day comfort and versatility with additional padding, an anti-microbial lining, and a removable insole.
*   **Prototipo RS - Red/Black/Orange comfort**: This shoe also offers all-day comfort and versatility with the same features as the Black/Red comfort model.
